data_fields.name: rank_thresholds
data_fields.donor_constant: per-rank points from renown_infos table (values not read)

best_idea: Pay each kill in rank points scaled by the victim's rank and level, split among nearby group members by rounded-down division, and carry any rank-up overflow into a reset progress counter.
decision_why: The victim-scaled award gives the PvP career rank a reason to hunt strong players; the donor's stored-total defect and null cap are fixed, and an anti-repeat rule is added because the donor has none.
acceptance: A server test kills the same rank-3 level-40 victim twice and sees 252 points the first time and less on the repeat under the anti-repeat rule; a stored 900 of 1000 plus 200 lands at rank+1 with 100 points; a player at the cap stores nothing and raises no error.
